method: Own retained PSGC code fixes tier; city_class HUC/ICC means level 2; otherwise existing PH state level plus 1 for city/municipality, plus 2 for barangay. Only missing-level rows considered. No names-alone binding. Every touched parent edge must be one level down. Population-only holds do not prevent classification. Contradictory or unproved identities and territorial scopes held.

sources.edition: PSGC as of 30 June 2026; released 13 July 2026
sources.role: identity crosswalk only; population columns never used

sources.edition:
Philippines administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 03.  
  
This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 17   
- Admin 2: 88   
- Admin 3: 1642   
- Admin 4: 11920   
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 01 April 2024: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 26 March 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 09 February 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 09 February 2018: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Philippines](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-philippines).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global) Source: National Mapping and Resource Information Authority (NAMRIA), Philippines Statistics Authority (PSA)
